enchantment.galosphere.enfeeble.desc: Salt pillars from the Saltbound Tablet slow the mobs they hit for 5 seconds.
enchantment.galosphere.rupture.desc: Salt pillars from the Saltbound Tablet burst into pink salt shards when they crumble: 3 shards at level I, one more per level.
enchantment.galosphere.sustain.desc: Salt pillars from the Saltbound Tablet stay up twice as long. Takes effect from level II.
enchantment.galosphere.sifting.desc: When you finish brushing a suspicious block, it has a 25% chance per level to refill so it can be brushed again.
